title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Says Goodbye After Season 4 Finale With Major Return
content: Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- has officially come to an end with the final episode of its fourth season this Summer, and with it has brought back a major character with a new release celebrating the occasion after the finale.
author: ComicBook

title: Light Novel 'Jaku-Chara Tomozaki-kun' Concludes with 12th Volume
content: The official X account for author Yuuki Yaku announced on Wednesday that the Jaku-Chara Tomozaki-kun ( Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki ) light novel series will end with its 12th volume, scheduled to be released on October 16.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Seirei Gensouki - Spirit Chronicles Anime Gets 3rd Season
content: The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Yuri Kitayama and Riv 's Seirei Gensouki - Spirit Chronicles light novels announced on Wednesday that the series is getting a third season. The anime's second season debuted in October 2024.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer Studio’s Next Big Movie Stuns With New Trailer – Watch
content: The studio behind Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba is coming back to theaters later this year with a brand new movie, and fans have gotten a final look at what to expect ahead of its release with a new trailer.
author: ComicBook

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Rem Epilogue Visual Revealed to Commemorate Finale
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 revealed a new Rem epilogue visual following its final episode (Episode 19) on September 30, 2026. This was the eight episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc .
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Seirei Gensouki' Receives Third Anime Season
content: The official website of the television anime adaptation of Yuri Kitayama 's Seirei Gensouki ( Spirit Chronicles ) light novel announced a third season on Wednesday. Produced by TMS Entertainment , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Summer 2021. A second season aired in 12 episodes in Fall 2024.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Black Clover Season 2 Might Be Taking a Road That Could Leave Fans Disappointed
content: After years of waiting, Black Clover is finally returning with a new season, picking up where it left off in March 2021, with Studio Pierrot having just started the Spade Kingdom arc.
author: ComicBook

title: Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles Season 3 Announced
content: Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles Season 3 was officially announced, along with a commemorative message from the author Yuri Kitayama. You can read the full message below: “Congratulations on the production of the TV anime Seirei Gensouki 3!
author: Anime Corner

title: Witch on the Holy Night Film's Final Trailer Unveils Staff, Theme Song
content: The official website of the Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) anime film started streaming the film's final trailer on Wednesday. The trailer reveals and previews the theme song "Yoru to Ao" (Night and Blue) by supercell , and it also confirms the staff.
author: ANN

title: Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar Anime Casts Risa Hayamizu
content: The official website for Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar ), the original television anime by French entertainment company Ankama , revealed a new cast member on Wednesday. Risa Hayamizu voices Mama Caroni, Welsh's adoptive mother and cooking mentor.
author: ANN
